    Puffin chick mortality from predation due to hunger

    calc_puffinmortality.Rd

    Determines whether a puffin chick dies from predation associated with poor body condition. Hungry chicks are assumed to spend more time near the burrow entrance, increasing their vulnerability to predators.

    Chicks whose body condition falls below the hunger threshold are assigned a probability of predation that increases as body condition declines. A stochastic draw is then used to determine whether mortality occurs during the current time step.

    Usage

    calc_puffinmortality(CoD, alive, BM_condition, BM_Chick_mortf)

    Arguments

    CoD

    Current cause of death. Typically "none" if the chick is alive.

    alive

    Indicator of whether the chick is currently alive (1) or dead (0).

    BM_condition

    Relative chick body condition, expressed as a proportion of the expected body mass for its age.

    BM_Chick_mortf

    Critical body condition threshold below which the chick dies from starvation.

    Value

    A character string giving the updated cause of death. Returns the original value of CoD if the chick survives.

    Details

    Puffin chicks with a body condition below 0.7 are classified as hungry. For hungry chicks, the probability of predation increases as body condition declines from the hunger threshold towards the starvation threshold (BM_Chick_mortf).

    Mortality is then determined through a binomial random draw. If mortality occurs, the cause of death is updated to "killed".

    See also

    calc_chickcare()

    Examples

    # Healthy chick
calc_puffinmortality(
  CoD = "none",
  alive = 1,
  BM_condition = 0.9,
  BM_Chick_mortf = 0.5
)
#> [1] "none"

# Hungry chick
calc_puffinmortality(
  CoD = "none",
  alive = 1,
  BM_condition = 0.6,
  BM_Chick_mortf = 0.5
)
#> [1] "none"

# Explore outcomes under repeated simulations
mortality <- replicate(
  1000,
  calc_puffinmortality(
    CoD = "none",
    alive = 1,
    BM_condition = 0.6,
    BM_Chick_mortf = 0.5
  )
)

table(mortality)
#> mortality
#> killed   none 
#>    499    501
